statement.notes: The schema requested only the 'depreciation_and_amortization' field. The value was directly available as a single line item in the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income...' section of the operating activities. The supplementary tables contain details on operating lease expenses and parent company cash flows, but these are not required to construct the requested field. The scale is 1E6 as the statement is in millions. All other fields from the schema (e.g., total_operating_cost, taxes, interest_expenses, marketable_securities) are not present in the provided data and are therefore not included in the output.
